text: The Greater Yorkville Residents Association requested amendments to the existing parking regulations on both sides of Critchley Lane, between Bellair Street and the west end of Critchley Lane. The intent of this amendment is to prohibit stopping within the laneway to prevent illegal parking and improve the two-way traffic operation. Transportation Services staff have been consulted and have no objection to the proposed amendment.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of Critchley Lane, between Bellair Street and the west end of Critchley Lane.
